simulation_effects: A skill action checks its source, method, available material or energy, cost, risk, target and consequence before execution.
Equipment may change tactical options, but broken, absent or unsuitable equipment cannot silently retain its effect.
Runtime loadout size, ranks, cooldowns, affixes and numeric values may change during UE5 balancing without a canon migration.
Symbiotic effects remain subject to Kenua-specific R2 boundaries and never become a generic player entitlement.
story_generators: Uma arma sintonizada com um mineral escasso obriga seu portador a escolher entre vencer uma luta e privar uma aldeia de tratamento.
Uma runa antiga funciona por segundos, mas o suporte começa a se desfazer e revela o nome de quem a construiu.
Dois jogadores aprendem a mesma técnica por caminhos opostos; seus custos sociais tornam os resultados irreconciliáveis.

compatibility.source_contracts: Skill, itemization and related implementation contracts are derived design sources, not lore authorities.
compatibility.godot: No code, scene, hotbar count or prototype number is ported automatically.
compatibility.unreal_engine_5: Future adapters consume the engine-neutral checks and preserve R2 identifiers.
